name: devenv
description: One-time machine and toolchain setup: mise + uv migration, Makefile generation, dotfiles symlink management, audited SSH key delegation, self-hosted GitHub Actions runners.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the devenv skills.

The authoritative mapping lives in `dEitY719/harness-skills` at `references/kimi-tools.md` (https://github.com/dEitY719/harness-skills/blob/main/references/kimi-tools.md) — read it when a skill names a tool you do not recognise. That repo is the sole owner for every repo in the `dEitY719/*-skills` family; this repo carries no copy. Summary:

- "Ask the user" -> `AskUserQuestion`. Every writing step must confirm through it first: `devenv:mise-migrate --apply`, `devenv:makefile-gen --apply`, every phase of `devenv:symlink-manager`, and `devenv:ssh-delegate add` / `revoke`.
- `TodoWrite` -> Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- "Dispatch a subagent" -> `Agent` with `subagent_type: "coder"` (implementation) or `"explore"` (read-only). Never pass `general-purpose`.
- Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob keep their exposed Kimi names. Search contents with `Grep`; match paths with `Glob`.
- `devenv:mise-migrate` is dry-run by default: without an explicit `--apply` it must print the plan and write nothing.
- `devenv:makefile-gen` is dry-run by default too; `--apply` refuses to overwrite an existing Makefile unless `--force` is also given (it then keeps `Makefile.bak`).
- `devenv:symlink-manager` moves a file out of its original location, so it must back the original up to `.backup` and verify the link before proceeding; a failed Phase 1 rolls back from that backup.
- `devenv:ssh-delegate` shells out to `lib/ssh_delegate.sh` through `Bash`; `add` needs a real TTY for its single `ssh-copy-id` password prompt, and a host-fingerprint MISMATCH from `sync` is a hard stop that only a human may clear.
- `devenv:runner-setup` starts a runner container on a remote host over SSH and registers it (always); its workflow rewrite is dry-run unless `--apply`. It refuses an existing `<repo>-runner` container and never puts the registration token on a command line.

interface.shortDescription: One-time machine and toolchain environment setup
interface.longDescription: Devenv bundles the five skills that set a machine up once and leave it reproducible: mise-migrate, makefile-gen, symlink-manager, ssh-delegate, and runner-setup.
